author: buildat
name: brimstone_speedway
title: Brimstone Speedway
description: A top-down death race of classic American cars on a demon's oval. Time trial: three laps against the clock, the lap records on a sign. Race: line up on the grid, start when ready, everyone goes at once; crates arm your car with a gun, mines or a ram boost, a wreck burns and puts you back at the last checkpoint; the places by who finishes first. The car, the race, its checkpoints, crates, mines and music are the game's types to change.
